summary: Zero-Waste Rendering: remove redundant and hidden work while preserving visible quality

changes.title: Event-driven glass and layout
changes.detail: Unchanged panel glass configuration no longer dirties its source or schedules another recording. Cache highlight shaders, stable view references and unchanged footer presentation; preserve all blur, tint, sampling, geometry and Clipboard slab behavior.

changes.title: Visible-only visual activity
changes.detail: Suspend hidden microphone pulse, glow masks, privacy artwork, key presentation, suggestion glyph overlays and particle animation without altering visible timings or voice/gesture functions. Deduplicate the private gesture UI deadline without extending its authorization.

changes.title: Less keyboard and swipe rendering work
changes.detail: Mark keyboard artwork dirty within the current draw instead of posting redundant frames, use one press-motion time per frame, and defer swipe trail buffer allocation until there is actual trail or clearing work. Preserve complete hardware display lists and swipe recognition.

changes.title: Lazy Emoji Search and public row reuse
changes.detail: Build Search keyboard on actual entry, rebuild only for stale layout or geometry, clear hidden Search rows, bulk replace grid keys with one coordinate pass, and reuse the persistent emoji row when data, geometry and fonts still match.

changes.title: Rendering allocation and regression safeguards
changes.detail: Reuse suggestion snapshot coordinates, avoid intermediate glyph comparison pairs, cache particle palette/blend state, and add policy and sequential-versus-bulk grid parity tests. No visible quality reduction or new permissions.

changes.title: Privacy-safe version history
changes.detail: Remove personal test-device references and contact or local capture metadata from bundled release descriptions, including older entries imported during builds. Preserve verified release identities, timestamps, feature behavior and signing. Check production sources and APK contents for known personal device identifiers before publication.
